Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill several weeks ago to replace our old Weber Silver Genesis which was nearly 25 years old.  The old grill served us well and had a surprising re-sale value even at that age.  The new grill, the Spirit E325 is smaller however since we are downsizing and moving to an apartment style condo, this new Weber fits perfectly.  The main repetitional feature of Weber grills is that parts can be ordered when necessary and the products are very durable and long lasting.  Based upon several weeks of use this new grill seems to fit all of our requirements, performing well when needed and allowing us to produce well cooked foods on demand.  One very minor feature which prevents me from rating 5 stars is that occasionally it is difficult to light the grill, specifically the middle burner.  The two outside burners seem to light on demand however the middle burner can occasionally be difficult.
Results.Title: Great little grill that seems to work fine.

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill because my wife and I wanted to downsize while still having a grill that would allow us to grill and griddle at the same time. As a result, I needed a model that would allow half of the grill surface to be replaced as needed with a griddle top. Weber's site listed a half griddle as an accessory for this unit, so I bought it plus the griddle. 

Well guess what? The half griddle that was listed as an accessory is for the *old* Spirit E-325 and does not work with this one. This knowledge was gained by actually using the griddle and grill, thereby making both unreturnable. So I am now the  owner of a grill that doesn't have the main feature I wanted, plus a pricey griddle insert that doesn't work for the grill. 

Hey Weber, here's a couple of ideas for you:
1. Don't reuse product names/model numbers over and over. It makes it real **** hard to figure out what works with what. The "new" E-325 has different starter mechanisms, different grill grates and different accessory compatibility. USE A NEW MODEL NUMBER. Reusing the model number is confusing and misleading. 
2 Update your **** web site in a timely fashion. This griddle was listed as a compatible option for several weeks while I decided what I wanted to do. 

Does the grill work? Sure. The problem is that right now it's a $300+ purchase I can neither take back nor use exactly as I intended so every time I look at it, it makes me mad and my opinion of it and Weber as a whole will reflect this situation.
Results.Title: Not as stated on web site
